title: 第5章 孵化第6章 授箓
content_zh:
“抢？”
陈知白不动声色放下，那枚在日照下隐现一抹弧彩的鸡蛋。
“没错！”
曾子昂趴在栅栏上，左右张望两眼，才压低声音道：
“我听说，修士若是横死，体内道箓有极小概率不会立即消散，而是与周遭之物，乃至活物融合，化为道器。若恰好与人相合……那便是天降道缘，一步登天了。”
他说完，脸上憧憬之色还未褪尽，愁苦又漫了上来：
“可惜，咱一介凡人，哪能碰到这种好事？”
陈知白闻言，心中那团迷雾骤然散开，终于明白自己为何会获得【装脏秘箓】？
他面上却只露出几分讶然与感慨，附和安慰道：
“船到桥头自然直，师兄也不必太过焦虑，尽人事听天命，用心准备考核便是，想必精诚所至，金石为开。”
“也只能这样了……”
曾子昂闻言又是絮絮叨叨一番，这才借了鸡蛋，唉声叹气地走了。
送走这位愁肠百结的邻居。
陈知白起身回屋，掩盖房门，于窗下静心凝神观察。
老律观如此重视五趾雀尾蛋，不惜以初玄道箓为赏，定有非凡之处！
然而看其外表，与寻常雀尾蛋并无区别。
对准太阳，仔细观察，也很难发现弧彩。
几经转动，才发现一道若隐若现的弧彩，看起来更像是眼角水花的折射。
“难怪曾子昂养鸡两年，也未曾发现，这般隐蔽，与大海捞针何异？”
陈知白摇了摇头，体内装脏秘箓微微一颤。

【鸡子】
——抱混形沌，藏太阳精，为五趾雀尾蛋。
“看起来和雀尾鸡没什么区别啊？莫非是因为尚未孵化，血脉不显的缘故？”
他沉吟半天，便不再纠结。
他心平气和的将剩下鸡蛋筛查一遍，确定没出双金之后，这才在五趾雀尾蛋上画个隐晦标记，随即准备孵化工作。
按照《养羽秘录》所言，雀尾鸡孵化需要21天。
不过，实际操作时间会有一定误差，总得来说，需要一个月左右。
“两个月都等过来了，也不差这一个月时间。”
正所谓，头胎照书养，二胎照猪养。
翻书一看，工序不少。
为了让母鸡抱窝，孵化的鸡蛋还不能少，至少得十颗起步，以母鸡腹部可以完全覆盖为准。
陈知白准备了十一枚“太子侍读”，共十二枚鸡蛋。
content_en:
"Rob?"
Chen Zhibai calmly put down the egg, which had a faint arc of color under the sunlight.
"That's right!"
Zeng Ziang lay on the fence, looked around, then lowered his voice and said:
"I heard that if a monk dies unexpectedly, there is a very small chance that the Taoism in his body will not dissipate immediately, but will merge with the surrounding things, even living creatures, and turn into a Taoist weapon. If it happens to match someone... then it will be a destiny sent from heaven, and he will reach the sky in one step."
After he finished speaking, the look of longing on his face had not faded away, and sorrow filled his face again:
"It's a pity. How can we, mere mortals, encounter such a good thing?"
When Chen Zhibai heard this, the fog in his heart suddenly dispersed, and he finally understood why he had obtained the "Secret of Pretending to be Dirty"?
But there was only a bit of surprise and emotion on his face, and he echoed and comforted:
"The boat will naturally be straight when it reaches the bridge. Senior brother, don't be too anxious. Just do your best to obey fate and prepare carefully for the assessment. I believe that with sincerity, the stone will be opened."
"That's all it can do..."
After hearing this, Zeng Ziang babbled for a while, then borrowed the egg and left with a sigh.
Send this sad neighbor away.
Chen Zhibai got up and went back to the house, covered the door, and observed quietly under the window.
There must be something extraordinary about the fact that Lao Lu Guan attaches so much importance to the five-toed bird's tail egg and does not hesitate to reward it with the Chu Xuan Dao Rui!
However, looking at its appearance, it is no different from ordinary sparrow tail eggs.
Aim at the sun and observe carefully, and it is difficult to find arc colors.
After several turns, I discovered a faint arc of color, which looked more like the reflection of water splashing from the corner of my eye.
"No wonder Zeng Zi'ang has been raising chickens for two years and has never discovered them. It's so hidden. How is it different from finding a needle in a haystack?"
Chen Zhibai shook his head, and the secret organ inside his body trembled slightly.
【Chicken】
——Embracing chaos, hiding the essence of the sun, it is a five-toed sparrow's tail egg.
"It looks no different from a sparrow-tailed chicken? Is it because it hasn't hatched yet and its bloodline isn't visible?"
He pondered for a long time and then stopped worrying.
He calmly screened the remaining eggs to make sure that they did not produce double gold, then he drew a vague mark on the five-toed sparrow's tail eggs and immediately prepared for hatching.
According to "Secrets of Raising Feathers", it takes 21 days for sparrow-tailed chickens to hatch.
However, there will be a certain error in the actual operation time. Generally speaking, it takes about a month.
"I've been waiting for two months, and it's not less than this month."
As the saying goes, the first child should be raised according to the book, and the second child should be raised according to the pig.
Looking through the book, I can see that there are quite a few steps.
In order for the hen to lay a nest, the number of hatching eggs must not be too few, at least ten, and the hen's abdomen must be completely covered.
Chen Zhibai prepared eleven "Prince's Attendants", a total of twelve eggs.
